title: Retention x stage-gap curves: compression-activated pre-minus-post effect (n=200)
sign_convention: Delta = pre - post, where pre = RBM pre-merger L2 top-k selection and post = post-merger L2 top-k selection. Negative => post wins at shallow compression (DocVQA 75%/50%).
plotted_quantity: delta_pp (spec panel definition: y = pre - post in pp)

units.pre: official accuracy fraction, 0-1 (TextVQA VQA-acc; DocVQA ANLS)
units.post: official accuracy fraction, 0-1 (TextVQA VQA-acc; DocVQA ANLS)

primary_source.lines: L28-39 (FIG:3 spec; audited n=200 value table at L31-36)
primary_source.note: authoritative layout spec; values marked official + audited; caption must state n=200 and never mix with full-split n

cross_checks.lines: L7-12 (budget-curve table A: L9 TextVQA Q3, L10 TextVQA Q2.5, L11 DocVQA Q3, L12 DocVQA Q2.5)
cross_checks.result: match: all 12 audited deltas identical to spec (incl. negative DocVQA points -1.3 / -2.1 / -1.4 at shallow compression)

provenance.rounding_note: pre/post fractions are the 3-dp values printed in the j8 digest; recomputing deltas from them gives +38.3 / +5.8 / +26.0 in three cells vs audited +38.4 / +5.9 / +26.1. The digest's own bold audited deltas match the spec exactly; the figure plots the audited delta_pp. Detail: runs/j8_summary.json (supp Table S3).
provenance.uncertainty: none; spec states no confidence bands available for n=200 subsets -> none plotted
